# Audit findings

Upstream: tmp/pi-mono/packages/tui/test/select-list.test.ts (5 tests — render with label/description/alignment)
Ours: apps/octo_pi_tui/test/octo_pi/tui/components/select_list_test.exs (10 tests — keyboard behavior + MVP render)

## Scope divergence

Upstream and ours test at different abstraction levels:

**Upstream SelectList**: items are `{value, label, description}`. Render produces a two-column layout (primary label + aligned description), with minimum/maximum primary column width, custom truncation hook, and multiline description normalization. No keyboard tests in this file (those live elsewhere upstream).

**Ours**: items are plain `[String.t()]`. No label/description, no column alignment, no truncation options. The moduledoc explicitly defers these to "Phase 4.1 — MVP is a plain list with arrow keys." Our tests cover the MVP's keyboard/selection behavior, which has no upstream counterpart in this file.

## MAPPED

None — upstream and our tests cover disjoint concerns.

## UNMAPPED (all 5 upstream)

1. normalizes multiline descriptions to a single line (`"Line one\nLine two\nLine three"` → `"Line one Line two Line three"`; no `\n` in rendered output)
2. keeps descriptions aligned when the primary text is truncated (two items with different primary widths — the description columns line up)
3. uses the configured minimum primary column width (`minPrimaryColumnWidth: 12, maxPrimaryColumnWidth: 20` → descriptions start at column 14)
4. uses the configured maximum primary column width (same config, but long primary text → descriptions start at column 22)
5. allows overriding primary truncation while preserving description alignment (custom `truncatePrimary` hook inserting `…`)

## Implementation gap

To port these tests we must first implement the upstream semantics in `OctoPi.TUI.Components.SelectList`:
- item struct with value/label/description
- two-column layout with min/max primary column width
- multiline description normalization
- truncation hook / theme protocol (selectedPrefix, selectedText, description, scrollInfo, noMatch)

Existing MVP keyboard behavior should be preserved; the upstream handle-key surface (scroll, filter) can land in follow-ups outside this ticket's scope.

## Action

Compliance ticket: port SelectList to upstream semantics and add the 5 tests. Depends on opi-q5k.31 (truncate_to_width) for correct ANSI-aware truncation.
